name: Recipes
description: A small recipe book: shelves, recipes, and recipes started from a meal in the Health Log.

permissions.description: Read and change your recipes, shelves and meal links (database xyz.tinycloud.sample.recipes/recipes). schema lets the app create its own tables on first open.
Read and change the app's one settings file (sort order, last shelf).
Read the installed copy of the app's schema. The app cannot change its own code.
Read and update the app's knowledge bundle so an agent can pick up where you left off.

Read access to the whole Health Log database (xyz.tinycloud.sample.healthlog/healthlog): its meals, its body-weight entries and its daily summaries. This app only reads meals, so you can start a recipe from one. Read only: it cannot change anything in your Health Log.
